MAHONIA_COLLATERAL.title: Mahonia collateral usability and accounting linkage
MAHONIA_COLLATERAL.status: Pre-existing investigative lead; not counted again.
MAHONIA_COLLATERAL.limitation: Previous reconstruction did not establish contradictory action or final accounting treatment.

UTILIQUEST_RETAINED_INDEMNITY.title: UtiliQuest retained indemnity and DASH correction
UTILIQUEST_RETAINED_INDEMNITY.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
UTILIQUEST_RETAINED_INDEMNITY.alternative: The author corrects the DASH and distinguishes joint-and-several liability from a guarantee/backstop; this could be appropriate disclosure and risk management.

RAPTOR_CAPACITY_AND_ASSURANCES.title: Raptor credit capacity and NewPower assurance limitations
RAPTOR_CAPACITY_AND_ASSURANCES.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
RAPTOR_CAPACITY_AND_ASSURANCES.deduplication: Conservatively count the broader Raptor capacity investigation once rather than each series/document as a new case. Related mechanisms are not authenticated same-thread messages.
RAPTOR_CAPACITY_AND_ASSURANCES.alternative: Failed sale treatment and credit-capacity exclusions may be correct accounting; timing/recipients of assurances and later corrective action need verification.

STEEL_CREDIT_INSURANCE_ADEQUACY.title: Steel credit-insurance protection claims and enforcement limits
STEEL_CREDIT_INSURANCE_ADEQUACY.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
STEEL_CREDIT_INSURANCE_ADEQUACY.alternative: The chain proposes controls and cautions about volatile MTM insurance; a completed deficient policy or knowingly false representation is not established.

HAWAII_125_0_TRS_RETAINED_RISK.title: Hawaii 125-0 FAS 125 monetizations with Enron total return swaps
HAWAII_125_0_TRS_RETAINED_RISK.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
HAWAII_125_0_TRS_RETAINED_RISK.why: Assets moved to the Hawaii 125-0 trust remain in Enron's total return swap VaR, so Enron keeps their price risk.
HAWAII_125_0_TRS_RETAINED_RISK.alternative: TRS-backed monetizations can be disclosed and accounted for correctly; whether the sale treatment and disclosure matched the retained swap needs the deal files.

LJM1_PUT_CREDIT_RESERVE.title: LJM1 (Rhythms) put options: credit reserve and the undisclosed credit-loss model
LJM1_PUT_CREDIT_RESERVE.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
LJM1_PUT_CREDIT_RESERVE.why: Enron's puts from LJM were worth about $100MM less after counterparty credit risk, Accounting argued for no reserve, and the model was not raised with Arthur Andersen.
LJM1_PUT_CREDIT_RESERVE.alternative: The position was being unwound; the reserve decision may have been documented elsewhere.

CHEWCO_JEDI_OWNERSHIP.title: Chewco owned in part by Enron; Enron entities 96.12% of JEDI I
CHEWCO_JEDI_OWNERSHIP.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
CHEWCO_JEDI_OWNERSHIP.why: An internal legal note treats Chewco as partly Enron-owned, which undermines treating JEDI I as unconsolidated.
CHEWCO_JEDI_OWNERSHIP.alternative: The note may describe ownership for Raptor bookkeeping only; outside equity in Chewco needs checking.

LV_COGEN_FRIEND_OF_ENRON_CONTROL.title: Las Vegas Cogen off-balance-sheet debt via a "Friend of Enron" investor
LV_COGEN_FRIEND_OF_ENRON_CONTROL.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
LV_COGEN_FRIEND_OF_ENRON_CONTROL.why: Debt off balance sheet and out of the footnotes because a friendly minority investor keeps the stated interest below 50%, while a call option gives Enron over 50% control.
LV_COGEN_FRIEND_OF_ENRON_CONTROL.alternative: Non-recourse project debt with a genuine minority investor can be off balance sheet; the call option terms decide it.

LGI_FIDELITY_GUARANTY.title: Landfill Gas Investments LP: Enron guaranty behind Fidelity's 99% interest
LGI_FIDELITY_GUARANTY.status: Initial credible investigative lead; not a wrongdoing finding
LGI_FIDELITY_GUARANTY.why: The outside investor's 99% LP interest was protected by an Enron Corp. guaranty, and the take-out was shaped so future buyers would not see it.
LGI_FIDELITY_GUARANTY.alternative: Tax-credit partnerships often carry indemnities; the exposure was small (about $5.3MM) and the question is disclosure, not loss shifting.
